evidence.name: Screen field: Where the media starts on top
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Where the media starts on top" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Where the media starts on top
sections.description: Sets where the media begins from the top of the screen. Screen Top runs it edge-to-edge to the very top (great for a full-bleed hero), Navigation Bar starts it just below the header, and Safe Area keeps it clear of phone notches and rounded corners. Pick Screen Top for an immersive banner, Safe Area when nothing should ever be clipped. This is locked if you set a media height percentage below, which positions it for you.
